name: 78ceb9-google-session
goal: Prove a stock Chrome website session survives container recreation, detect ended Google sessions without DevTools and notify Chief of Staff only on confirmed expiry.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Review of #445: the guest uses a real Chrome profile but never checks Google state and the E2E only persists a fixture file. Desired behavior: check a normal Google Account page from the existing browser, return a closed status only, and retain the website session on encrypted executor storage.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen the protected Chrome source assertion and existing no-network Docker smoke. Check a synthetic HTTP session before sign-in, after the website sets a cookie, after Chrome and the container restart, and after expiry. Unknown or failed navigation is distinct from expiry.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Loop record captured f455091690 with the existing protected Chrome case failing because the installed website session probe was absent. Same suite: bunx --no-install vitest run test/adapters/execution-runtimes/container-browser.test.ts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: b716bd6e9b installs an executor-only fixed-site Chrome probe, opens and closes a separate window, uses Linux accessibility only for the top-level destination, and retains the existing X browser target.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged focused test passed at b716bd6e9b under the same environment and command as failed f455091690. Real Docker browser startup and full session lifecycle are verified separately.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
